name: Jason Altmire
bio: a Representative from Pennsylvania; born in Kittanning, Armstrong County, Pa., March 7, 1968; B.S., Florida State University, Tallahassee, Fla., 1990; M.H.S.A., George Washington University, Washington, D.C., 1998; D.B.A., University of Florida, Gainesville, Fla., 2020; staff, United States Representative Pete Peterson of Florida, 1991-1996; professional advocate; elected as a Democrat to the One Hundred Tenth and to the two succeeding Congresses (January 3, 2007-January 3, 2013); unsuccessful candidate for nomination to the One Hundred Thirteenth Congress in 2012.
